description: This file implements the sqlstore for managing team and team member data in Mattermost, including CRUD operations, member management, role updates, and various queries related to teams and their members.

classes.name: SqlTeamStore
classes.description: Struct implementing team and team member database operations.

methods.name: NewTeamMemberFromModel
methods.description: Converts a model.TeamMember to a sqlstore teamMember struct.

methods.name: teamMemberSliceColumns
methods.description: Returns the list of column names for teamMember slices.

methods.name: teamMemberToSlice
methods.description: Converts a model.TeamMember to a slice of values for SQL queries.

methods.name: wildcardSearchTerm
methods.description: Generates a case-insensitive wildcard search term.

methods.name: getTeamRoles
methods.description: Determines roles for a team member based on scheme and explicit roles.

methods.name: (db teamMemberWithSchemeRoles) ToModel
methods.description: Converts a teamMemberWithSchemeRoles struct to a model.TeamMember.

methods.name: (db teamMemberWithSchemeRolesList) ToModel
methods.description: Converts a list of teamMemberWithSchemeRoles to a list of model.TeamMember.
